requirement: A site build that hangs ends: the host stops provision after 15 silent or 60 total minutes, the sweep fails a build still running after 75 minutes, and the wizard says when it cannot reach the build or the build is gone

oracle.ref: PR #1403 (fix); fix evidence: provision.js ran provision.sh with no timeoutMs; cron skipped running jobs for ever; the client polled with no cap. Local stand: "fetching webroot" ran 1110 s then failed; EmDash docker builds sat 29 and 49 minutes until the host restarted
oracle.invariant: S1: the first is stopped by the silence (idle: true, a log line saying so); the second runs to its end. S2: run was given timeoutMs 60 min and idleMs 15 min; the job fails with reason idle and a detail naming the silence. S3: left alone inside the limits; failed (reason timeout / host-unreachable) and the creation settled past them. S4: unreachable true after two minutes, asking goes on, false once an answer lands; the gone build shows the form with the note 'gone'.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
